summary: The production persistent-v3 caller needs selected nonces, exact command and runtime input binding before BindInput; private bundle directories and cleanup IDs appear later. The cited shared pure CommandRecipe now supplies actual RootlessMechanism and inactive-manager/host commands and binds the target, custody identity, selected source inputs, parent/work/evidence paths, nonces and bounded cleanup ceiling. The CLI requires a root-owned private canonical recipe; canonical closed parsing and recomputation refuse changed commands or inputs. Actual inert C4/full control-flow tests compare the complete normal/cleanup stream and four captured census removal IDs. This source contract is not production native acceptance. Existing fixed native slot binding, host-UID0 directory ownership and UID32768 child traversal remain unchanged: the next reviewed window needs delayed selected-slot capabilities, trusted captured-result cleanup and an authentic mapped engine/provisioner profile. Recipe shape and synthetic fixture ownership never supply that missing authority.
title: Production command recipes precede native capability binding
